_comment: GOAL's configuration (tools/jira/projectconfig.py PROJECT_FILES): copy to program_configuration.goal.json and fill in. Same layout as program_configuration.json; the environment block needs services.hospitality_internal_all_v2 (GOAL's calls), and goal.availability lists the candidate properties the tests search for availability. Jira / Confluence / Xray settings for GOAL stories go in this file too.

groupmaintenance._comment: Named database block. An imported JDBC step whose connection string points at .../groupmaintenance runs through Db.forDatabase("groupmaintenance"), which reads database.groupmaintenance.* here and falls back to database.* when none of these is set. Add one sibling block per database name.

stg._xray_comment: Result publishing. Xray CLOUD wants an API key PAIR (clientId + clientSecret, from Xray > Settings > API Keys). Xray SERVER / DATA CENTER wants a Jira personal access token in `token` and no pair at all. The flavour is inferred from `baseUrl` -- a self-hosted host means Server/DC -- or state it with `flavour`. `enabled` is the master kill switch and stays false until someone turns it on. `projectKey` is only needed on Server/DC when no testExecutionKey is given.
stg._jira_comment: Read-only Jira access for the story-to-test tooling (tools/jira/). `base_urls` is an ALLOWLIST: a story URL whose host is not listed is refused rather than fetched, so a pasted link cannot redirect the fetcher at an arbitrary target. `pat` is a personal access token -- it is sent as a header, never placed in a URL or a log line. Leave the whole block empty to disable the tooling.
stg._confluence_comment: Confluence for the story-to-test tooling (tools/confluence/). Same rules as jira_config: `base_urls` is an ALLOWLIST and includes the context path if there is one (https://host/confluence); `pat` goes in a header only. `publish.create_page` lets the workbench CREATE pages, and only in the spaces listed -- leave it false until you mean it. In jira_config, `publish.attach` likewise lets it attach files to issues; add `"projects": ["ABC"]` beside it to limit which.
